note: SNR-mismatch robustness of LMMSE and the experiment-02 MLPs on validation run 0056 (odd 50-snapshot blocks reported; LMMSE loading chosen on even blocks); test run 0057 untouched

config.noise: Y = add_noise(Hv[:, p], 10**(-true/10), seed=1000*n_obs+true), as experiments 01/02
config.fairness: LMMSE (rho chosen on even blocks at the assumed SNR) and SNR-aware MLPs get the same assumed SNR; mlp_blind ignores it; designs frozen per assumed SNR

definitions.grid_axes: lists are [true SNR index][assumed SNR index] over snrs_db; SNR-free methods (linear, mlp_blind) have one index (true SNR)
definitions.seed_average: MLP numbers without a seed key: per-block squared errors averaged over seeds, then NMSE
definitions.gain_over_lmmse_db: NMSE(LMMSE designed for the assumed SNR) - NMSE(method) at the same (true, assumed); positive = method better; CI: paired block bootstrap, B=1000
definitions.offset_loss_db: mean over true SNRs t with t+offset on the grid of NMSE(t, t+offset) - reference(t); vs_own_matched: reference = the same method at (t, t); vs_matched_lmmse: LMMSE at (t, t)
definitions.fixed_design: NMSE vs true SNR of receivers designed for one assumed SNR; lmmse_matched knows the true SNR
